bug_semantics: An authenticated course student (role 3) can bypass navigation/button hiding by directly loading /courses/{course-id}/settings#share or /courses/{course-id}/people?add=true. The settings route renders the restricted course configuration and share link; the people page instantiates an invitation dialog whose open state is controlled only by the user-supplied add=true query. In v0.1.13 that dialog loads organization tutors (including names/emails), exposes the student invite link and QR code, and presents add-member actions. This is an object-keyed course authorization failure: membership is accepted where an admin/tutor role check is required. The advisory demonstrates unauthorized interface/data access; successful persistence of every offered mutation was not independently established and its CVSS vector records integrity impact as none.
flaw_origin: The disclosed lifecycle has two code origins. The earliest is the public one-parent Space merge boundary 103a2eda7b039f6ee1fb9ea524c41b0a85fe158e, which first adds src/routes/courses/[id]/settings/+page.{js,svelte}; its CourseContainer computes isStudent, Navigation hides Settings for students, but CourseContainer unconditionally renders <slot />, so a direct URL bypasses the UI-only restriction. That commit is a squash aggregate whose message enumerates multiple CLASSROOMIO-T-90 member commits; the original member objects are absent, so it cannot be accepted as the smallest true BIC. The invite-query half is independently reconstructable: member commit 9f04d4e3a7dd3335ea8fc7db10efe78eab1431a7 first adds checkQueryParamAndOpenModal() for add=true while leaving only the Add button inside RoleBasedSecurity; it was later squashed as 82eee93417616e4dce0cec9ef30a988da07231c9. Commit 80dc3923461b21699a17157bdfdb050694fca1a5 later added the exact settings#share and people?add=true card links, but is not causal because both direct-access surfaces already existed.
ai_marker: The only public commit object at the earliest settings-origin boundary, 103a2eda7b039f6ee1fb9ea524c41b0a85fe158e, says author 'emmanuel <ifeanyi@digdippa.com>', committer 'Space Cloud <noreply@jetbrains.space>', human Co-authored-by trailers for Ifeanyi Nwosu and Rotimi Best, and no Co-authored-by AI identity, Generated-with trailer, or bot author. That absence cannot classify the unavailable true member BIC. The separately recovered invite member 9f04d4e3a7dd3335ea8fc7db10efe78eab1431a7 likewise has human author/committer tunny17 <tvnji01@gmail.com> and no AI marker, but it is not the missing earliest settings BIC.
evidence: The first-party advisory bundle for GHSA-px6j-wc84-gwhf/CVE-2025-65672 identifies ClassroomIO 0.1.13 and CWE-639. The linked researcher disclosure at https://github.com/Rivek619/CVE-2025-65672 gives the student attack paths /courses/{course-id}/settings#share and /courses/{course-id}/people?add=true and reports access to Share Settings and Invite/People Management.

Run `git log -L 1,27:'src/routes/courses/[id]/settings/+page.svelte' 103a2eda7b039f6ee1fb9ea524c41b0a85fe158e` and `git log --all -S'CourseContainer bind:isStudent' -- src/routes/courses/[id]/settings/+page.svelte apps/dashboard/src/routes/courses/[id]/settings/+page.svelte`: both identify 103a2eda7b039f6ee1fb9ea524c41b0a85fe158e. `git show 103a...:src/lib/components/CourseContainer/index.svelte` shows role_id === 3 sets isStudent but the page slot is unconditional; the corresponding Navigation file hides Settings with show() { return !isStudent; }.

Direct boundary-parent check: `git rev-parse 103a2eda7b039f6ee1fb9ea524c41b0a85fe158e^` returns e44353ac0a429694405e0b13494c6041d842bcb1; `git ls-tree -r --name-only e44353ac0a429694405e0b13494c6041d842bcb1 -- 'src/routes/courses/[id]/settings'` is empty, while `git diff --name-status e44353a... 103a2ed... -- 'src/routes/courses/[id]/settings'` reports both +page.js and +page.svelte as added. This proves absence at the public boundary, not at the unavailable member-commit boundary.

`git cat-file commit 103a2eda7b039f6ee1fb9ea524c41b0a85fe158e` reproduces the Space Cloud squash object, its single parent, the long list of embedded CLASSROOMIO-T-90/T-14x member subjects, its human co-author trailers, and no AI trailer. Searching all 5,714 commit objects exposed by `git cat-file --batch-all-objects` for the embedded CLASSROOMIO-T-90 subjects finds only the three rebased copies of this squash (103a2eda..., caa5b2f8..., eec1c1ab...) and later squashes that quote it; no original member commit object is present.

Invite-side decomposition: `git show 9f04d4e3a7dd3335ea8fc7db10efe78eab1431a7` adds add=true parsing and opens invitationModal from the URL while the Add button remains under RoleBasedSecurity. Its direct parent f890bb4bbb65efde0b569bdad365c74cebba2bf2 has only the protected button/store-controlled modal and no query parser. `git show 0b61becdbe1e5d4f7c5d03a3819ff4e0b6792d1a` refactors the same flaw into open={addPeopleParm === 'true'}; public squash 82eee93417616e4dce0cec9ef30a988da07231c9 contains these members and is an ancestor of v0.1.13.

At v0.1.13, `git show v0.1.13:'apps/dashboard/src/lib/components/Course/components/People/InvitationModal.svelte'` shows addPeopleParm = query.get('add'), open={addPeopleParm === 'true'}, unconditional getOrgTeam($currentOrg.id), tutor email mapping, invite-link/QR generation, and addGroupMember submission. The people layout protects only the visible Add button with allowedRoles={[1, 2]}; direct query navigation bypasses that wrapper.

Version boundary: `git rev-parse v0.1.13^{}` returns 876a785b3c467b809804f56e0981bff448fcfdb5. `git tag --contains 103a2eda7b039f6ee1fb9ea524c41b0a85fe158e` includes every release from v0.1.0 through v1.0.0, and `git merge-base --is-ancestor 82eee93417616e4dce0cec9ef30a988da07231c9 v0.1.13` succeeds. Thus the advisory's 0.1.13 is directly verified; the settings exposure starts no later than v0.1.0 and the query-triggered invite exposure is present by v0.1.13.

No closing fix exists in the validated history through main f08f6c6838259ca440299a82f5d100d44d5349cd. `git show v1.0.0:'apps/dashboard/src/routes/(app)/courses/[id]/settings/+page.svelte'` renders CourseSettingsPage and a Save button without a role/ownership gate. The v1.0.0 invitation-modal object still derives isOpen solely from URL add=true and loads tutors/students when open. The current main files retain the same route-level omission and query-controlled dialog, while RoleBasedSecurity remains around only the normal Add button. Therefore fix_sha/direct_fix_sha are null because the disclosed access-control flaw remains unpatched in the examined tags and tip, not because a fix could not be located.
reasoning: The vulnerable behavior is not the later addition of convenient card links; it is the mismatch between UI hiding and route/modal authorization. Direct parent and line-history checks prove when each surface appeared. The invite member history can be decomposed to 9f04d4e3a7dd3335ea8fc7db10efe78eab1431a7, but the earlier settings route landed only as a Space squash aggregate. Because the protocol rejects squash aggregates as BICs and permits AI judgment only from the true BIC commit object, the public aggregate's lack of AI markers is insufficient for NOT_AI. The missing member history is a genuine public-history boundary, so BLOCKED is required. Separately, tag and tip inspection establish that there is no fix boundary: the vulnerable UI-access pattern persists through v1.0.0 and main.
remaining_gap: The original JetBrains Space merge-request CLASSROOMIO-MR-76 member commit SHA/object that first added the unguarded settings route is absent from the GitHub history and from all reachable/unreachable commit objects in the validated clone. Without that true member BIC object, its author/committer/trailers cannot be inspected for the protocol's BIC-only AI signal. This is a non-obtainable public-history boundary; the vulnerability itself and its continued unpatched status are established.
